propositions: Four graph functions have elevated cyclomatic complexity (CCN 16-22): _find_direct_blockers (18), _get_all_blocked_by (20), check_cycle_at_level (16), detect_newly_unblocked (22).
Two identical "reduce_all → drop error/fsck → index" loops are duplicated verbatim in _find_direct_blockers and _compute_dep_graph, driving unnecessary complexity.

Two distinct BFS traversal patterns in _get_all_blocked_by and check_cycle_at_level re-implement identical queue/visited bookkeeping logic with different node-set semantics (accumulator vs visited distinction).

Refactor adds load_indexed_states helper to eliminate the first duplication and bfs accumulator skeleton to consolidate the second pattern, reducing all four functions to CCN ≤ 8 while preserving node-sets and traversal results.

The refactor is behavior-preserving: existing test suites pass unchanged, a new characterization test validates the accumulator-vs-visited distinction, and complexity baseline entries for all four functions drop below the 15-point threshold.
